subject: Req: compliance pricing for multi-region pilot (audit logs / HSM / residency)
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@apexhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Req: compliance pricing for multi-region pilot (audit logs / HSM / residency)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team liked the routing/fallback story. We are putting together a small proof-of-concept (pilot) across Singapore and Sydney regions and need a clear proposal from Redwood that covers:

- Audit log retention and ingestion pricing (we expect ~400GB/month of detailed logs during the pilot).
- KMS/HSM access model: whether you charge per-HSM-seat, per-concurrent-signature, or as a blended monthly fee.
- Data residency surcharge for APAC multi-region setup (how you handle cross-region reads for failover).
- Any add-on setup / migration fees and minimum terms.

Attached is our short compliance requirements doc. Procurement will need line items we can compare to other vendors. Our tentative timeline is pilot starting mid-July.

Can you send a pricing sketch with assumptions and a recommended packaging approach that minimizes variable per-request cost for audit logs? Also please include what discounting looks like for a 12-month committed pilot (est. $60k ARR run-rate).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Head of Cloud Integrations
Apex Health Systems

Attachments: Apex_Compliance_Requirements_2026-06-18.pdf (pdf)

---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req: compliance pricing for multi-region pilot (audit logs / HSM / residency)

Thanks for the clear requirements, Sarah — appreciate the attachment. High level response below; Ben and Marissa are copied for pricing and SOW details. I'll follow up with a spreadsheet that breaks the numbers out.

Quick summary (recommendation):
- Audit logs: charge = base ingestion tier + incremental per-GB after tier. For pilots we recommend a 500GB/month ingestion tier for a flat $1,200/mo (retention 90 days). Option to add longer retention at per-GB/month. This minimizes per-event unit cost during the test.
- HSM/KMS: offer two options: (A) "Seat" model — dedicated HSM seat per region at $2,000/seat/month (includes 5k signatures/day); (B) "Usage" model — $0.0025 per signature for bursty workloads with no fixed seat fee. For the pilot we suggest one HSM seat in Singapore and a passive failover in Sydney (seat price + regional residency surcharge).
- Residency surcharge: 15% on base hosted API usage for multi-region guarantee (failover + active-active read restrictions). If you prefer single-region with DR, we can drop to 8%.
- One-time setup: $6,000 for audit ingestion connectors, schema mapping, and onboarding scripts.
- Discounts: standard pilot concession = 10% on the first 6 months for 12-month commitments at $60k ARR. We can discuss a deeper commitment-based discount (up to 18%) if you expand to production with a 24-month Reserved Capacity commitment.

Open items for your input:
1) Confirm retention target (90 vs 365 days). Longer retention materially changes storage cost and discounting.
2) Are you okay with a per-region HSM seat for failover, or do you want a shared HSM across regions (shared HSM increases latency/security considerations)?

I'll attach a quick calc and ask Ben for final price and SLAs.

Best,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Compliance_Proposal_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@apexhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Req: compliance pricing for multi-region pilot (audit logs / HSM / residency)

Dylan / team — reviewed the numbers and put together a cost table and a concise commercial proposal. Copying the key lines here for Sarah so procurement has immediate visibility; detailed calc is attached.

Pricing proposal (pilot / 12 mo commitment) — Apex Health Systems
- Audit log ingestion: 500GB/month tier = $1,200/mo. Additional GBs at $0.015/GB. Retention 90 days included.
- Audit log export (if you need snapshots sent to your S3): $75/month per export endpoint.
- HSM/KMS: Recommended = 1 seat in SIN (active) + 1 passive seat in SYD for DR. Seat pricing = $2,000/seat/month. For pilots we can provide the second (passive) seat at 50% list ($1,000) for the first 3 months.
- Residency surcharge: 15% on Redwood hosted usage and on compliance add-ons for multi-region active-active.
- One-time setup & connector engineering = $6,000 (waived if you sign a production Reserved Capacity by end of Q3).
- Pilot concession: 12-month purchase equals 12% discount applied to base monthly fees (audit + seats + residency) for first 6 months.

Net example (month 1):
- Audit tier: $1,200
- HSM seats: $2,000 (SIN) + $1,000 (SYD first 3 months concession) = $3,000
- Residency surcharge (15% of 4,200) = $630
- Total monthly (pre-discount) = $4,830
- After 12% pilot concession (first 6 months) = $4,250.40

Commercial terms / conditional crediting:
- If you commit to a production Reserved Capacity within 90 days of pilot close, Redwood will credit back onboarding fee ($6,000) and apply a one-time $5,000 implementation credit towards the first invoice.
- Price lock: pilot pricing held for 12 months on signed SOW; production reserved capacity will be set by the Reserved pricing schedule.

Notes on HSM model: the seat model provides deterministic P95 encryption latency and is preferred for PHI workflows. Usage model pricing may be cheaper for very low signature volumes, but unpredictable for spikes during overnight batch jobs.

Please confirm Sarah: retention target + whether you want active-active across both regions (higher surcharge) or active/passive for the pilot. If you confirm, I'll prepare a short SOW and push a DocuSign envelope for signatures along with a line-item price table suitable for procurement.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw_audit_ingress_pricing_table.csv (csv)

Dylan / Ben,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the detailed table. A few clarifications from our end before we circulate to procurement:

- Retention: start with 90 days for the pilot. We'll review production retention separately.
- HSM: we want the seat model for SIN (active) + passive seat in SYD (per your recommendation). The passive concession for month 1-3 looks fine.
- Residency: we'll take active/passive for the pilot (please apply the 8% surcharge instead of 15% for active/passive).
- Discounts: 12% pilot concession accepted for first six months. Could you confirm the exact effective date the concession applies from (invoice date or SOW signature)? Procurement prefers concession to start on the invoice date.

Can you send a one-page SOW + line-item table we can attach to the PO? Also please include the DocuSign link and indicate whether the $6,000 onboarding fee will be invoiced or can be netted against the implementation credit upon production commitment. Procurement prefers credits instead of separate negative invoices.

If we can get that by end of week, procurement will issue a PO and we can target the mid-July start.

Thanks,
Sarah
